listing.name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons (ACNHRecomp)
listing.summary: Experimental AArch64 main/sdk/subsdk0 to C++ native Vulkan from Wonder framework. Upstream maturity: Opening/island free walk30fps; first full-day/save unverified, forcing60fps doubles game speed, online unavailable, bird-head rendering bug. Acquisition: No releases; source launcher/bash setup imports/recompiles/builds locally; Windows setup requires Linux/Mac/WSL2. Platforms: Linux x64 Ubuntu/IrisXe tested. Apple Silicon MoltenVK scripts untested. Windows unsupported: launcher may build/use elsewhere-generated folder but no native pipeline offer. Android unsupported. Original data: Own ACNH baseNSP plus3.0.2updateNSP title01006F8002326000; prod.keys required, title.keys recommended, DLC optional. Separate firmware folder not required by root; exact regional/build digest Unknown. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
